guardian.title: Privacy
guardian.intro: Your privacy, where you can see it: who hears what you say, whether anything may leave the device, and what the assistant sent out on the network.
guardian.now.title: Right now
guardian.hint.browser: Your browser's own speech recognition: in Chrome that is Google, in Safari Apple. Choose a local plugin in the voice settings for speech that stays here.
guardian.hint.server: What you say goes to a server. Choose a local plugin in the voice settings for speech that stays here.
guardian.local.cannot: This device has no plugin that can switch the network off, so it cannot go local only.
guardian.local.wentOffline: Local only is on: nothing you say leaves the device.
guardian.net.title: What went out
guardian.net.nolog: There is no network log on this device, so Guardian cannot see what went out. Install ovos-network-log to keep one.
guardian.net.sumRefused: Refused, because the device was local only: {n}.
guardian.ask: Ask "what did you send out today?", "who hears what I say?" or "go offline" to hear the same.
guardian.hint.serverVoice: The voice is made on a server: the text of its answers goes there.
guardian.hint.browserVoice: The browser's own voices: some of them are made on Google's or Apple's servers.
